title: LLMs for Multi-Modal Knowledge Extraction and Analysis in Intelligence/Safety-Critical Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that assesses LLM alignment and self-perception by administering human behavioral and political affiliation tests, such as the 'political compass' and 'g7 members political' datasets.

Reviewing fairness vulnerabilities in literature to evaluate whether models provide consistently reliable and balanced treatment across different subgroups, specifically noting different languages and dialects.

Reviewing recent literature and compiling existing benchmarks (e.g., the BBQ hand-built bias benchmark for QA and the COMPAS inmate recidivism risk score) used to measure inequity, injustice, and stereotyping in LLM outputs.
